data.name: About_Description
data.value: HoboLibris keeps, organises and syncs your Kobo and Kindle books. It backs up the books in your Kobo account and on your Kobo eReader and Kindle to this computer, sorts your eReader into collections, and sends your own books to the eReader. Files are copied exactly as they are: nothing is decrypted or converted.

data.name: Kindle_Note_StorageClosed
data.value: Your Kindle is connected and the cable carries data, but the Kindle is keeping its storage closed, so Windows sees an empty drive. That's also why it isn't listed for ejecting: you can simply unplug it. To open it: 1. Unplug the Kindle. 2. Restart it: hold the power button for about 40 seconds until the screen goes blank, then let go and wait for it to start up (or use Settings, Device Options, Restart). 3. Plug the cable straight into this computer, not into a hub, keyboard or monitor. 4. Don't tap anything on the Kindle. Its screen should change to "USB Drive Mode" or a picture of a computer, and your books will appear here by themselves. If the Kindle only shows that it's charging, try another USB port on the computer.
